race.description: Ladbrokes Big Bets Copy Now Hcp (Bm62)
race.comment: TWISTED LOVE (8) gets the nod. Two runs back have been good, just finding one better at Mornington before a close up effort at Caulfield Heath. Finds a lovely race third up and should be very hard to hold out. CAELIUS (4) ran a good race first up at Sale over 1415m, getting back and running on well in a bunched finish. He was unsuited there given the tempo and could settle closer from the gate up in trip. ICARO (1) is going quite well since a win three back. The draw isn't kind to him but if he can find a back to follow he'll be hard to hold out. TOLPUDDLE (6) was just fair last time out to 2030m at Mornington and has been freshened since. Back in trip should suit him much better.
